newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp to sell desk-top PC with LCD monitor - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sharp to sell desk-top PC with LCD monitor - paper.

text.p: Sharp Corp will start selling desk-top personal computers (PCs) as early as spring 1997, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said it will be the first time for Sharp to sell desk-top PCs.

The paper said the desk-top computer will have a liquid crystal display (LCD) monitor. It will also have a DVD-ROM (digital video disc read-only memory) drive so that a user can enjoy various multi-media functions, the paper said.
Sharp spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.
Sharp's desk-top PC is meant for home use, the paper said.
Sharp is aiming for a price between 300,000 yen and 400,000 yen, the paper said.
The desk-top PC will also be introduced in the United States after being introduced in Japan, the paper said.
